recipes.label: Slightly Weary
recipes.startdescription: The attack poses no real threat, yet it still manages to trouble me somewhat—
recipes.description: it will consume a portion of my surplus stamina.

recipes.label: Restless Agitation
recipes.startdescription: This assault poses no real threat, yet it still troubles me somewhat—
recipes.description: it will temporarily disrupt a portion of my mind.

recipes.label: Defenseless!
recipes.startdescription: I failed to muster enough strength to resist the enemy, and now I will pay the price—

recipes.label: A setback!
recipes.description: As long as I still retain even a sliver of spare strength, I shall not suffer overly grave injury — but this portion of power will require some time to recover.

recipes.label: I'm Hurt!

recipes.label: Mind Wounded!
recipes.startdescription:
My reason is thrown into chaos, my passion dwindles and wanes—

[Be warned: if both reason and passion are injured, mental strikes will directly kill you.]

recipes.label: In Utter Despair
recipes.startdescription: Darkness swallows all. My consciousness helplessly sinks.

recipes.label: Burden of the Mind
recipes.startdescription:
My reason lies shattered into gleaming fragments, my passion withers like leaves in the wind—

[This damaged Ability card cannot recover on its own; beware: if both Reason and Passion are already wounded, a mental strike will kill you outright.]
